deploybot: 🏷️ Tag created: release/2025-11-02-v1.12.0 (tag: v1.12.0) commit: abcdef1234567890
Changelog (high level):
- auth: reduce token validation latency (PR #4021)
- runtime: improve KV cache eviction heuristics (PR #4033)
- infra: nginx upgrade + cert rotation (ops)
Canary env: staging -> canary-runner
Prod plan: canary 15m -> evaluate metrics -> 60m gradual rollout -> full
Change window: 2025-11-02 02:00-05:00 UTC (change window A)
Rollback criteria: sustained 5xx > 0.5% for 5m OR p95 latency regression >30% vs baseline OR error spike on /v1/generate
Safety net (ffwd): if any of the above triggers, immediate traffic cut to stable pool + auto-pin to v1.11.9 for affected routes
Pin request: ops, please hold any manual pins until we decide on rollback; if rollback happens, pin workers to v1.11.9 per runbook
Docs & diff: https://redwood.example.com/releases/v1.12.0
Related PRs: https://git.example.com/r/redwood/runtime/pulls/4033, https://git.example.com/r/redwood/auth/pulls/4021
Action items: ops/SRE - confirm canary start + health checks. If green, follow gradual rollout schedule. If not, trigger rollback and notify product.
Git commands used:
```
git tag -a v1.12.0 abcdef1234 -m "release v1.12.0"
git push origin v1.12.0
```
— deploybot

celeste: quick q — any DB migrations or schema bumps in this cut? :eyes:

jamal: no schema changes. There is a config flag flip (kv.eviction_policy) that needs a secret reference update in prod. @matt ops will handle secret rotation?

anika: I uploaded detailed release notes and linked PRs to the docs page. Added a short regression test list. Link: https://redwood.example.com/releases/v1.12.0/notes

matt: ops will rotate the secret at 2025-11-02 01:30 UTC. After rotate, I can kick off the canary. ETA + confirmation once done.

sre-bot: Canary health checks scheduled: p95 latency, error 5xx rate, kv cache hitrate, memory RSS. Alert thresholds set; will post dashboard and brief every 5m during canary.

jamal: hold pattern acknowledged. @deploybot please set canary to 10% incoming traffic for 15m, then 30% for 45m if metrics stable. Also enable auto-cut to stable pool on threshold breach.

celeste: noting mobile SDK pin request — i'll open a tiny PR to bump the client constraint to v1.12.x after this lands.

anika: ops/SRE — once canary is green, please run the smoke suite: `./scripts/smoke auth` and `./scripts/smoke/generate --small`. Post results in this thread.

matt: running secret rotation now, will reply with timestamp when complete.

deploybot: Canary started at 2059876588, target 10% traffic. Canary dashboard: https://grafana.example.com/d/abcd/canary-v1-12-0 (short link). Logs streaming to: https://logs.example.com/q/xyz
Keep this thread for updates; tag me with any rollback decisions. :rocket:
